reviews.author: Nicholas H.
reviews.text: Excellent stay, much quieter than the last time we visited. The site was perfect - not so close to the restroom you could smell it, but close enough to walk at night.

reviews.author: Joel R.
reviews.text: The campground is well situated for exploring the park our only complaint is that we thought we had a pull through site, and backing out travel trailer into the site we ended up with was challenging.

reviews.author: Shubhrata P.
reviews.text: Great campground! The toilets are close by and kept very clean. there are a lot of mosquitoes here.

reviews.author: Matthew J.
reviews.text: Great amenities, clean bathrooms. Wild that there is a cart guy driving around in case you need anything! Makes visiting the crater very easy and care free, especially for those with kids. The campsite wasn’t rowdy and we actually got sleep and enjoyed the quiet.

reviews.author: Anne P.
reviews.text: We were concerned about check in time as we arrived earlier than expected. The check in time wasn't mentioned or an issue. I would recommend changing that on the reservation confirmation so people can plan accordingly and not feel stressed or dissonance for arriving early. Facilities were clean. I'd go back for sure!

reviews.author: Ryan A.
reviews.text: great campsite, very clean. G22 is in front of the spigot so it was super convenient and there is a lot of wood to help start a fire. Lots of mosquitos so have bug spray with you.

reviews.author: Tom G.
reviews.text: Great campground. Unique Patk

reviews.author: Adnan A.
reviews.text: Good

reviews.author: Vanina D.
reviews.text: Very well-stocked store. Clean bathrooms, free hot showers. It gets really cold at night including during the summer, so bring blankets!

reviews.author: Aroa C.
reviews.text:
Beautiful park, great spots, good shade, spacious, and confortable.
Clean bathrooms.
Friendly employees!

reviews.author: Juanita H.
reviews.text: This is a lovely campground, with a nice trail accessible from the campground and more trails accessible by car within this gorgeous national park.  Be aware that there are no showers in loop G, where I stayed.  There were three showers in nearby loop F, but all three were closed.  Also, be aware that, while you can buy ice in the camp store, it is $12 a bag, so it's best to stock up on ice and other items outside of the park.

reviews.author: Gavin B.
reviews.text: Great campground super close to the main village. One note is the showers were not warm at all. I didn’t expect them to be but incase this helps someone know what to expect I thought I should share!

reviews.author: Jennifer T.
reviews.text: Campground was very well organized. Clean restrooms.

reviews.author: Gary S.
reviews.text: If you’re bringing an RV, verify the size of your selected site. We ended up just barely squeezing in…Site #F-16 was tight for our 20’ trailer. Two more feet and you’d be in the road. We did gymnastics fitting the tow vehicle and trailer in that spot.

reviews.author: Perry R.
reviews.text: The campsite was separated from neighboring sites, lots of trees, clean, and beautiful!

reviews.author: Ruth B.
reviews.text: Great campground— clean, quiet, well maintained, and with a great little store with many essentials. Stayed in a tent, and quiet hours were observed by RV folks.

reviews.author: Sandeep J.
reviews.text: Helpful staff. Quiet and peaceful campground. Restrooms are clean. Restaurant on site.

reviews.author: andy s.
reviews.text: Warning - this review is brutally honest.  We arrived at the Mazama Village just after sunset on a cold and wet evening. Being our 1st time there, we ventured into the store and checked it out to realize the shop was well stocked and very very expensive. We got some basic instructions from the staff about the location of facilities and were off to our site. The campsite was adequate with poorly maintained roads. Even worse were the very poorly cleaned bathrooms. The next morning we went to the showers. This is after we were in Canada and other locations on the way in Oregon and Idaho, to find the facilities terribly old and so very unsanitary. The shower drain was similar to the open trough system used 20 years ago in sporting arena's. Really think twice before exposing your loved ones to these facilities. Things are poorly out dated and sadly overpriced.

reviews.author: Brian R.
reviews.text: Awesome camp ground nice spots and a short drive to the crator

reviews.author: Curtis B.
reviews.text: Clean and quiet. Close to the store and hiking trails.

reviews.author: Curtis B.
reviews.text: Clean and quiet. Close to the store and hiking trails.

reviews.author: Dawn M.
reviews.text: Nice, clean campground, very friendly staff

reviews.author: Annthony K.
reviews.text: Great campground. Site C-19 is a very nice tent site. Store is well stocked and the staff very friendly and helpful. Bathroom was clean.

reviews.author: Katherine G.
reviews.text: Campground was mostly empty; rangers were helpful.

reviews.author: Stephan  W.
reviews.text: Poor customer service! When there were available cabins and I wanted to upgrade due to rain- was told yes by one employee and no by another. Additionally, all showers were closed except main public shower room. Campsite was nearly flooded

reviews.author: Ana R.
reviews.text: Our site had full hookups (electric, water, and sewage) with lots of space for large RVs and cars. It was close to a restroom and a hiking trail.

reviews.author: Traci S.
reviews.text: I spent one night as a solo traveler at Mazama Village campground. It was clean, close to the store and restaurant but far enough away to be secluded. I did not have any company by me on a weeknight, which was great for privacy. It was a great stay all in all!

reviews.author: Keith D.
reviews.text: Nice site. It does not have shade but it was cool so that worked well. The site looks out at a field where deer grazed. I would pick this site again.

reviews.author: David M.
reviews.text: Experienced a Great visit to Crater Lake.  New staff at reservation desk were helpful in making on-site reservations.

reviews.author: TIMOTHY H.
reviews.text: Excellent campground with amenities very close including a clean, free, hot shower.

reviews.author: Kristin H.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our night here. The nearby trail was beautiful to walk. The tent area was nice and flat. The bathroom was clean.

reviews.author: Rich C.
reviews.text: Everything is great here

reviews.author: Orea W.
reviews.text: It was nice and quiet. Loob B close to the store for back and forth needs. Bathroom, water spout all close by. Neighboring camps sites also close by so it does not seem isolated. We took advantage of the EV charging near park entrance and restaurant. Also a hiking trail near by that we unfortunately did not get to take advantage of. Would recommend and stay there again due to proximity, safety, ev charging source and bathroom/shower amenities.

reviews.author: Ellie U.
reviews.text: Campsite was quiet, amenities clean, and showers within the camp store were clean and hot!

reviews.author: Dieter W.
reviews.text: Good infrastructure and service, nice area

reviews.author: Esma G.
reviews.text: it was great. Nice campground.

reviews.author: Stephanie H.
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time! The camping store had some great essentials, and the showers were clean and well maintained. Our site, tent site, was well maintained too. Only issue was the grill we had with our campground; it was not cleaned out and the grill portion itself was bent so badly all our cookware leaned making it hard to cook on. Other than that, the bathrooms close to our site were very clean and always had toilet paper. Highly recommend staying here.

reviews.author: Chun L.
reviews.text: recommend

reviews.author: Camryn D.
reviews.text: Mazma was a comfortable stay. The free showers were a plus! Our spot had mostly level paved parking, which was helpful for the rooftop tent on our truck. Bear lockers at each site were also a blessing.

reviews.author: Laura T.
reviews.text: Very nice campground, clean, lots of tree's to make it secluded, great ice cream shop and general store.

reviews.author: Kelton G.
reviews.text: This site is by the dump station which meant there was some traffic during the day but honestly it wasn't disruptive at all. No smells or nuisance, everyone was quick and respectful. It was actually nice to be a bit separated from the other campsites. Clean bathroom right next to the campsite and the showers at the store were nice and hot. The only downside to this site is I found a mouse in my van on my last night. I'm pretty sure he was in and out after he didn't find food in my rig, didn't make his home in my home thank goodness and I didn't see or hear him the day after.

reviews.author: Kelton G.
reviews.text: Had an excellent night, nice and cool during an unseasonable heatwave. Other campers were quiet and respectful.

reviews.author: Kevin P.
reviews.text: Was ok, slept well

reviews.author: Janet C.
reviews.text: Great location to Crater Lake. There are showers, flush toilets, gift shop/store, gas station, and restaurant all nearby.

reviews.author: Samantha G.
reviews.text: Great campground! The sites and restrooms were clean and the road is well-maintained. The sites are spacious and ours felt very private with all of the trees and shrubs. The rangers were really friendly and hosted talks each night. It was also convenient to have access to trails from the campground. Would definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Jennifer C.
reviews.text: We didn't have reservations for our site but arrived at 2:30 pm on Sunday June 7th and were able to secure a FF site A 14.  Fantastic site overlooking the river and canyon.  Private with trees surrounding us yet plenty of room.  Perfect for us and our camper van set up while utilizing the picnic table and fire pit.

reviews.author: Johann S.
reviews.text: The campgrounds are excellent, and the on-site trail is a must-visit. Some sites inside the loop lack privacy, so if that matters, choose one on the outer edge, which is right on the canyon's edge. The location near Crater Lake is convenient, and although it was very hot at Crater Lake, the trees and shade at the campsite made it quite comfortable.

reviews.author: Freddie R.
reviews.text: Incredibly lucky to have found a site upon just showing up but then again, tourism is way down and international tourism is gone. The campground is clean and neat. Large number of sites but it always felt secluded. Clean bathrooms although there were showers only in the main building. The park itself is spectacular.

reviews.author: Jin L.
reviews.text: Great and nice place

reviews.author: Randy H.
reviews.text: Very good first come first serve campground for when we visited. They only had 3 loops open when we got there on June 12th. Very nice sites.

reviews.author: Matthew D.
reviews.text: The campground was nice, well-maintained and convenient.

reviews.author: Jack P.
reviews.text: First come first served process worked well enough despite only two looos of campground open. Reduced pricing for senior lifetime pass holders is a blessing.  Would have like campground showers to have been available but they were not. Had to shower at store at south entrance instead.

reviews.author: Cynthia E.
reviews.text: The campground and facilities was clean and very well maintained.  You can only get WiFi at the office/store, but they have a few outdoor areas you can sit in and enjoy. I gave it a 4 ⭐️ because the store was ridiculously expensive. Overall it was a great place to stay and will likely return.

reviews.author: Dana K.
reviews.text: crowded  but nice

reviews.author: Isabel  M.
reviews.text: Very clean! Everyone was helpful and friendly. The lake is unbelievably beautiful. Campsite bathrooms were very clean.

reviews.author: linda k.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground well maintained. Lovely hike right from the camp down to a wandering creek.

reviews.author: Alexa P.
reviews.text: We had our first experience with first come first serve camping, and it went well. We chose spot A8 which was a pretty decent size and somewhat private compared to others. The river looks directly behind it on the map, but its deep in a valley off a steep drop off, so be careful with young kids! The staff at the front desk were very nice.

reviews.author: Darin P.
reviews.text: Large campsites, plenty of firewood on the ground, clean restrooms, easy access to store for supplies and showers

reviews.author: Chelsea S.
reviews.text: The birds were aggressive for food so make sure you keep an eye on anything being left out but it was such an amazing experience! Would definitely camp here again!

reviews.author: Charlie C.
reviews.text: Even though you were close to your fellow campers, you still had enough privacy. Loved camping here. Convenient store nearby.

reviews.author: Katelyn H.
reviews.text: A private site nestled in trees with plenty of space for one or two tents. On a slight slope.

reviews.author: Chunsi C.
reviews.text: Beautiful national park, very close the this campground.

reviews.author: Angelina H.
reviews.text: Enchanted forest camping with decent access to an incredible place. With so much room, however, I don't understand why campsites are packed in so close to neighbors? Crater Lake National Park would do well to incorporate more bike trails, bike lanes, and be more accommodating to bikes in general. That goes for all of our National Parks.

reviews.author: Andrew S.
reviews.text: The site was filled with downed trees. It was difficult to find two tent sites.

reviews.author: Roberto G.
reviews.text: This campground was a great base for the park. Not too loud at night. Can easily bike for kids. The snack shop and shower setup was nice.

reviews.author: Michele T.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our time at Mazama Village Campground. We had a nice, spacious campsite and the whole campground was beautiful and well-kept. The campground is within walking distance to the camp store and the Annie Creek restaurant and gift shop and is a good starting point for all of your adventures within the park.

reviews.author: Carl H.
reviews.text: This campground is a great location for the Crater Lake experience.  Store is well equipped and gas is available. Campsites are nice size with plenty of privacy. No problem obtaining a campsite on first come first serve basis. Reservations must be made months in advance like all National Parks.

reviews.author: Camilo A.
reviews.text: Perfect size campsites. The grills are small and ground level, there are near boxers for overnight storage. Showers have warm water, and there are multiple all over the campsite.

reviews.author: Daniel B.
reviews.text: Paid personnel were friendly and helpful

reviews.author: Wayne R.
reviews.text: Nice park with many activities and sights to see. You won't be bored here.

reviews.author: Philippe S.
reviews.text: Had a great experience at Mazama Village Campground. Sites are clean and well spaced out. Bathrooms are clean and really appreciated the free hot water showers located at each bathroom.  The cafe has a good menu for all meals and the general store has everything else. Minutes away from the Crater Lake, Mazama Village Campground really made everything perfect.

reviews.author: David S.
reviews.text: Nice campground nestled in the pines. We enjoyed our stay here greatly. There is a minimally stocked store nearby, with super helpful staff. We would easily stay here again.

reviews.author: Mark C.
reviews.text: Really great camping experience.

reviews.author: Jer Y.
reviews.text: Great location to the lake and nearby hiking trails.

reviews.author: amy t.
reviews.text: Great family get away to see Crater Lake

reviews.author: Don L.
reviews.text: The bathrooms were closed in our circle, the showers had cold water. The rest of our experience was awesome. We love camping at Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Jeffrey F.
reviews.text: It's been 4 months since we were there, but I recall the toilets were in need of cleaning when we arrived.  The site was quiet and reasonably spacious.  I was disappointed there was no evening program (and likely there had not been one in quite some time as the amphitheater was deteriorating); that was a highlight in the past.

reviews.author: Kim S.
reviews.text: need showers

reviews.author: Daniel G.
reviews.text: The campground itself was average. The location is better than average. There is an interesting loop that can be hiked.

reviews.author: Lisa G.
reviews.text: Clean facilities. Close to everything and the view of half dome from our site was incredible

reviews.author: Charles L.
reviews.text: What a great place to camp

reviews.author: Tom D.
reviews.text: Great grounds with helpful staff at the check-in building with everything you could need at the small store.

reviews.author: Michael M.
reviews.text: Beautiful location amongst the trees. Pull-thru sites are nice but difficult to get in properly for longer rigs because the site pad is narrow and curved with large rocks lining the edges of the site. We have a 35' fifth wheel and had to make quite a few adjustments to get aligned properly. Great location for seeing the park and enjoying the outdoors.

reviews.author: Ammarah M.
reviews.text: Campgrounds are close to each other but great location to explore crater lake.

reviews.author: Caroline M.
reviews.text: sites were spacious and nice amongst trees. Bathrooms in campground were ok. The shower house was adjacent to the shop and not clean at all. Also hours were limited (we like to shower in the evening). I went first thing in the morning and the water was not draining and it had not yet been cleaned from the day before. Gross.

reviews.author: Erin R.
reviews.text: Great campground, easy access, bathroom and showers available for a short walk. Nice little hiking trail from the campground.

reviews.author: Regina S.
reviews.text: Great campground

reviews.author: Aaron S.
reviews.text: Mazama campground was a beautiful setting, quiet with plenty of space. The bathrooms were clean.

reviews.author: Lin H.
reviews.text: disappointed in road closure

reviews.author: Randena M.
reviews.text:
Staying at this site was a delight! The location was fantastic- quiet at night, walking distance to Curry Village restaurants and shops. The cabin was well maintained, clean, comfortable, nicely decorated and everything worked. Our cabin had 2 beds and a dresser and we were comfortably about to fit a pack-n-play in as well. I’m not a great camper and we have a baby, but the cabin made “camping” very accessible to me. We were really pleased with the whole experience. Never having stayed inside the park before, you get a totally different experience staying inside the park. Kudos to the cleaning and maintenance staff! We can’t wait to book again! 
Also the first weekend of October was a lovely time to visit, low crowds, good weather.

reviews.author: Rachel Q.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground with everything you need. There is no service in the area, but the main lodge/grocery store is a short walk away, and it has wifi and an excellent restaurant.

reviews.author: Jim R.
reviews.text: Campsites were okay but bathrooms were very neglected.  I used to own a campground and a resort so know first hand how to clean a bathroom.  The toilets in the building near our site the first night not only had not been cleaned that day but probably not that week or even longer.  For a National Park this is an embarrassment to our Country.  I hate to think what a foreign visitor would think seeing such filthy conditions.  I have photos should you want to see.

reviews.author: Thomas H.
reviews.text:
Wonderful campground. Lots of firewood on the ground just need a chain saw to cut . Ice and firewood were expensive but you were in the national park. Wonderful restruant good pizza
Only complaint was the handy cap shower door did not have a lock or latch, appears to have been this way for sometime, a $5 hook could of easily solved the issue

reviews.author: Travis B.
reviews.text: Really clean campground, restrooms and showers were clean. Love to see recycling option for cans, etc. close to store and restaurant. Would definitely stay again. Would like to see diesel fuel option at the store as many RVs are diesel these days.

reviews.author: Walter H.
reviews.text: Great location to take advantage of Crater Lake NP.

reviews.author: Ben W.
reviews.text: Good camp ground, not isolated but if you want that there is a lot of nearby BLM land. Great for ride the rim

reviews.author: Alex R.
reviews.text: Clean campground; got showers; great location from Crater Lake hikes and bike rides.  Can’t wait to go back.

reviews.author: Nina S.
reviews.text: Nicely laid out campground - spacious with privacy, tables and fire rings, clean bathrooms with flush toilets, level parking for our camper van. Just know that it was VERY cold, as in frost, in mid Sept. Glad we were in the van.

reviews.author: Shannan T.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. Excellent staff!

reviews.author: Kristin W.
reviews.text: Nice campground.  I never did find the showers though. Giving out a campground map at check-in would be nice.

reviews.author: Andrew S.
reviews.text: Campground and staff were excellent. Restaurant had a great staff, menu, and service. Thoroughly enjoyed the trolley tour.

reviews.author: Anable A.
reviews.text: It was easy to access the campgrounds. Great for beginner camping. And I would recommend hiking the Annie Creek Canyon Trail next to the campgrounds it was beautiful and the flow of water was soothing.

reviews.author: CARLOS CESAR M.
reviews.text: Our recent stay at Mazama Village Campground was disappointing. The staff member at check-in was not welcoming, and the restroom facilities were in poor condition. Information provided within the campground was unclear, making it difficult to navigate. We hope to see improvements in both service and maintenance in the future.

reviews.author: Eric W.
reviews.text: It was nice staying here late in the season because the campground was relatively quiet. Considering that so few campers were there to make a mess, I was surprised that the bathrooms were not very clean.

reviews.author: Bradley O.
reviews.text: Overall very happy with our stay at Mazama Village. The sites felt quite private, despite the size and density of the campground. No issues with our electrical hookups; the provided bear-proof cabinet worked great; water and bathrooms were both nearby. Only issue was one of the two showers was out of order and the other had a clogged drain. Still, the water got hot and it didn’t cost quarters like we’d anticipated, so it still got the job done ok.

reviews.author: Katarzyna  P.
reviews.text: Really great campground, clean bathrooms and everything is well maintained

reviews.author: Marie R.
reviews.text: Lovely clean, quiet, well maintained campground.  We stayed in G loop and walked to the Annie Creek Canyon trail just a few sites down from ours.

reviews.author: Sarah J.
reviews.text: Lovely campground with plenty of room. Only recommendation would be a few signs to the camp loops.

reviews.author: Kenton S.
reviews.text: Nice campground. Close to the Crater lake rim. We had a great time.

reviews.author: Aaron J.
reviews.text: This is a great campground with nice facilities. Great showers and bathrooms. Some site are more private than others, but looked each site was well maintained.

reviews.author: Paul B.
reviews.text:
The spacious, wooded campsites are wonderful.
The firepit and picnic table were in good shape and we enjoyed using them.
Bathroom facilities were, also, well maintained.

reviews.author: Amy W.
reviews.text: Semi private sites depending on where you are located. Nice bathrooms with lights that came on at night. Sites are level, have picnic table and a bear cabinet.

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.text: Tight spots. No privacy. Mainly tents and small rv's, camper vans in the campground. Other campers were respectful and quiet.  But, man the spots are packed in and lack privacy.

reviews.author: Giovanni C.
reviews.text: Mazama Campground benefits from a great location, and because of that, they don't care much about quality. My campsite itself was clean and spacious, but the facilities left a lot to be desired. The entire campground has only one shower area (with an additional shower at the general store during limited hours). The restroom near my site was consistently filthy and never had paper towels. I followed the usual advice to buy firewood locally, but the price at the general store was steep—$13 per bundle. If possible, buy your firewood nearby but outside the campground. Overall, the location makes Mazama Campground worth considering, but the management doesn’t appear to put much effort into maintaining the facilities or creating a welcoming experience.

reviews.author: Eric A.
reviews.text: If you like hearing the garbage truck come through the campgrounds at like 6:00 am then it’s great otherwise

reviews.author: Nancy B.
reviews.text: We enjoyed camping at the campsite, lots of space.  The bathrooms are vary clean.  I wish they have shower facilities and electric site.  But overall, it was a great visit.

reviews.author: Merritt Z.
reviews.text: Quiet and peaceful. Close to amenities.

reviews.author: Heath B.
reviews.text: Good campground plenty of room with lots of trees. Bathrooms were not the cleanest but overall a good place to stay.

reviews.author: Laurence  O.
reviews.text: Very private and quiet. Nice bathroom facilities. Plenty of loose sticks for a campfire (we brought our own kindling and logs).

reviews.author: Molly W.
reviews.text: This is a lovely campground. We camped in D loop and had a spacious site with lots of tall trees, pleasant surroundings, and a nice walking trail right behind our campsite that looped down into the canyon behind the campground. The proximity to the village store and Crater Lake itself was absolutely fantastic. It was a quick drive to the visitor centers and any hike we wanted to do by the lake. The showers at the village store, just a couple minutes from our campsite, were warm and free. My only complaints concerned the restroom near our campsite and the complete lack of dishwater disposal. There was only one restroom for our whole loop, and it looked like this was the case for most loops at the campground. It was fairly clean, but each side had only one sink with cold water only and a button that had to be held down to keep the water flowing so you could only rinse one hand at a time. Also our reservation confirmation said there would be drains for dish water in front of each restroom and there was not! We couldn't find dishwater disposal anywhere in our loop which made doing dishes a huge pain.

reviews.author: Amanda N.
reviews.text: We had a good experience for the most part but it was a bit noisy after quiet hours and there was a gas smell.

reviews.author: Prasanth R.
reviews.text: Campgrounds are very small.

reviews.author: Leslie R.
reviews.text: SO CROWDED!  And so many generators.  Holy cow.  Insane.

reviews.author: Laurie F.
reviews.text: Perfect location for us to navigate the park over two days. Convenient to Annie’s Creek restaurant (for great dinners) and accessing the hikes we wanted to do. Site was deep, semi-private with trees and convenient to water and restrooms.

reviews.author: Steven M.
reviews.text: The campground was excellent!. Fire pits for S’mores and clean bathrooms were nice after backpacking for 3 days in between the two nights we stayed there.  We were in section G both nights which was quiet and overlooked Annie Creek.  The Annie Creek canyon trail was as beautiful as anything we saw during our 5 day camping and backpacking trip in Crater Lake National Park and having dinner in the restaurant named after Annie Creek after the conclusion of our backpacking was a welcome respite from rehydrated food.

reviews.author: Karen C.
reviews.text: Very nice, spacious campground.  Flush toilets and clean bathrooms.  Incredibly beautiful location.

reviews.author: Joanna T.
reviews.text: The campground sites were spacious, the facilities were clean, and the staff was professional.

reviews.author: Shirley  P.
reviews.text:
The campground needs a lot of maintenance.  The office/ check in store is run down and not clean.
Some front staff needs training and were cold and indifferent. 
Some were great.
Sanitary station hoses leaked incredibly bad and everything got soaked from a tall fitting leak that could be easily fixed.

reviews.author: Jean B.
reviews.text: This campground is very nice. The spaces are large, level and shaded. We would have appreciated having the bathrooms cleaned. Overall, it was great though.

reviews.author: Leslie R.
reviews.text: Tried for a spot a couple of weeks before we were heading to Crater Lake and of course they were full. Signed up on the Wait List, never expecting to hear anything. A week before the date we planned on visiting the park, got two notices of cancellations. We were able to secure one of the spots and it turned out to be one of the best campsites we have ever had- F9. (No hook-ups, but we tent, so it worked just fine for us.)  Big, clean spot with a beautiful view of the canyon. Campground was very quiet at night. Picked up pizza from Annie Creek Restaurant by the General Store and brought it back to our site. Nice amenity for a campground!  Bathrooms and showers served their purpose.  Truly one of our favorite campsites and we have been camping for over 30 yrs.

reviews.author: Jane B.
reviews.text: Good bathrooms. Nice that we could buy hot coffee in the morning!

reviews.author: Victoria L.
reviews.text: Great campground although several big rigs pulled in and used their loud generators all night which totally ruined the experience for tent campers. Great store, bathrooms, restaurants, gas (expensive) on site.

reviews.author: William  R.
reviews.text: Signage in the campground after “checking in” is worthless.   About as worthless as the guy in the store that didn’t check us in, just told us to go to our reserved spot.  Funny my reservation still shows open (on the app) the night after I used it.   I was told at the gate to check in at the store.   I did, he acted like we (me and a stranger) were idiots.  The signs are nonexistent from in front of the store to the campground.  Me, and two others I didn’t know did the exact same thing and drove past the cabins.

reviews.author: Heather A.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at Mazama. We appreciated the hot shower with great water pressure, clean bathrooms, nice camping spots with fire pits, plus the convenience of the store and restaurant! And it was easy to access a hiking trail from our camp that went along a a nice stream.

reviews.author: Barbara S.
reviews.text: The campsites were beautiful with lots of room between them.  I especially loved the sites on the edge of the canyon.  Dark skies were very visible with lovely star-filled nights.  My only complaint is the cleanliness of the shower stalls, and the lack of wi-fi.  However, as the desk service person gently stated, here is a place to "disconnect."  Wi-fi is available in the restaurant and at the check-in office.

reviews.author: Jo-Anne N.
reviews.text: It’s a lovely campground with plenty of trees. The store is well stocked. Firewood is pricy. The lake is a sweet walk away and very beautiful.

reviews.author: Dave H.
reviews.text: Clean campgrounds, nice pull thru campsites

reviews.author: Gabriela O.
reviews.text: I really enjoyed this campsite, the layout is a little funky but totally worked for us. The water and trash were very close and the bathroom was not a far walk. I appreciate how close the site was to the store and the trail heads (about 20 mins to watchman peak). Would def come back and stay for longer next time

reviews.author: David L.
reviews.text: Good experience.

reviews.author: Jon B.
reviews.text: Average campground.

reviews.author: ysabel s.
reviews.text: Campsite clean, nice flush toilets. Nice camp store with plenty of options. Nice relaxing overnight stay.

reviews.author: christopher m.
reviews.text: The campground is great. The only issue was the camera my friend and his wife found in one of the vents in the showers in F row. The rangers were call and the camp concessionaire were notified. I dont know what became of the event, I doubt the concessionaire took the event seriously nor checked the other showers.

reviews.author: Janet W.
reviews.text: Site F20 was tight due to 2 huge boulders. But the effort was well worth it!

reviews.author: Alyssa P.
reviews.text: Good area to camp, and clean bathrooms.

reviews.author: Alyssa C.
reviews.text: Great place to stay! Very conveniently located inside Crater Lake Nat Park. Super close to the general store, which I didn't realize had showers and a gas station. Definitely competitive to get a spot, but a nice campground overall with running water and bathrooms. Very clean, had everything we needed. Not much privacy, i.e. not many trees or anything between each campsite, but still very nice.

reviews.author: Jordan Boon Xiang O.
reviews.text: Great site. Has a water spigot nearby.

reviews.author: brittany  m.
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my time at this campground and the site was very spacious. It was also very close to the campground store (free WiFi and showers!) and just a short and pretty drive up to the rim. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: DEYI J.
reviews.text: The camp ground is well maintained and very convenient close to shops and restaurant. The food in the restaurant and gas at the station are lower than surrounding communities. F loop has two showers.

reviews.author: Les C.
reviews.text: Nice campground. Most sites are large enough to have your own space. Bathrooms were nice and the showers were free. Showers were at the camp store and one building in the campground. We at at the campground restaurant and the park lodge. Both were good.

reviews.author: Deidra J.
reviews.text:
Cean facilities, nice staff. Loved the shower amenity.  Short drive to camp store, visitor center and trails. 
Only downside for us was minimal to no cell service.

reviews.author: REX J.
reviews.text: Great experience.  Very nice campground and support people.  Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Ewa B.
reviews.text:
My campsite was a total river. The guy at the reception said there were no other campsites available even though the other attendant SOLD 3 campsites while we were talking. Then he claimed he could not issue a refund since it was past some hour. I ended up sleeping outside of the park. 
Terrible customer service, worst I have ever encountered in a national or state park.

reviews.author: Tomas S.
reviews.text:
Strengths: Location could not be better. Facilities (bathrooms, trash cans, parking) are convenient, the store has gasoline, a range of food, and wifi. 

Improvement opportunities: Bathrooms could be a bit cleaner. The campsites have quite a bit of a view of each other - but the night was quiet.

reviews.author: lauren b.
reviews.text: Phenomenal campsite right in Crater Lake! Easy quick drive to a lot of great hikes on the west side of the park. Bear lockers are a great size at each site, which is so helpful. Bathrooms were clean and worked great!

reviews.author: Rudy M.
reviews.text: Great campsites, lots of trees well layer out so each site had privacy. Bathrooms clean an well maintained unlike those at Rim Village 😵‍💫

reviews.author: Rhiannon C.
reviews.text: Friendly staff, campgrounds were easily marked. Camp store was great. Clean free showers!!! Campground itself was clean and well maintained

reviews.author: Gaurav S.
reviews.text: Great campsite. Clean with free showers close by in the loop. Anne Creek right behind out campsite.

reviews.author: Sonya C.
reviews.text: Crater lake is a must see experience. It was wonderful to be so close. It hailed at the campground and our friends site turned into a moat around their trailer. Our site had better drainage.

reviews.author: Larry H.
reviews.text:
Great site with trees. Quiet. Showers were very nice. 
Just wish they had more sites with electric

reviews.author: Jan S.
reviews.text: Shuttle to Crater Lake, nice trail directly at campground, campground in general very nice

reviews.author: Arman Y.
reviews.text: Lots of bugs and flies and unclean bathrooms

reviews.author: Tiffany F.
reviews.text: Our site was tucked  away a little bit from the other sites so it felt very private even though there were other campers nearby. It was a big spot and was able to accommodate our two tents easily with room for more. Bathrooms were clean (flush toilets and illuminated!) and just on the other side of our loop.

reviews.author: William  C.
reviews.text: Loved everything about it.

reviews.author: Laura R.
reviews.text: I have stayed at many campgrounds and this one is by far one of the most peaceful.  We tent and had a lot of privacy.  The sites were all very large with reasonably close water spigots.  The only negative - the bathroom in our loop could really use some updating.  The staff did their best to keep it clean, but we opted to use the bathrooms near the camp store with the showers.

reviews.author: Melody L.
reviews.text: Great camping place. Rode the trolley to Rim Village. It was great not to have to pack up the RV to see more of Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Lucas F.
reviews.text: It was beautiful

reviews.author: Michele M.
reviews.text: The ground where it was level to place a tent was covered with ant nests and other critter holes, so we moved our tent to the edge of the plot so we wouldn't be camping in ant beds. The first night was delightful with quiet and stars galore. The weather both nights was great. The second night we had new neighbors on one side (the close side) and they stayed up until 11 pm talking loudly, shining their headlamp all over our site (not on purpose), then arguing loudly for another hour.  I did not want to say anything to them, like "Quiet time was at 10 pm" because it was possible alcohol was involved and I did not want to get involved and possibly make it worse.  So I lay in my tent wide awake.  Noisy, rude, clueless neighbors are not in your control, but it ruined the second night.  Maybe next time I'll find a more remote campsite.  On a good note, the bathroom was clean and everyone else was very nice and accommodating.

reviews.author: Kyle H.
reviews.text: We had a perfect camp site that only took a few minutes to get to after our day cruising around the national park. Grounds were clean, neighbors were respectful and the bathrooms were in good shape. Thanks for making our trip special and easy!

reviews.author: debra g.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground. Large spaces.  Very clean restrooms.  Appreciated the showers too!  Great staff

reviews.author: Daniel P.
reviews.text: Site was more spacious than anticipated. Restroom maintenance can struggle, but they did address very gross clogged toilets over night.

reviews.author: Bryan P.
reviews.text: Nice campground, clean spots, glad to have bear (squirrel) lockers

reviews.author: Bryan P.
reviews.text: Clean spots, helpful staff, squirrels are a little aggressive 🤣

reviews.author: Karen V.
reviews.text: Nice campgrounds, I enjoyed my stay there

reviews.author: Gemma H.
reviews.text: One of the best campsites we’ve been to in a National Park. Spacious, quiet, and well maintained.

reviews.author: Gabrielle R.
reviews.text: Convenient, large campsites on beautiful grounds, great weather while we were there. the camp store is convenient though posting the hours for it (and the attached showers) would be helpful (I think they close at 9).

reviews.author: Dhruv P.
reviews.text: Well maintained campsite. Showers are available for free in loop F as well as Mazama Village store.

reviews.author: Bruce D.
reviews.text: Wonderful large campsite. Very quiet campground. Only complaint is that we couldn’t really use our fire ring because it was located in a very poor spot by the road even though we had a huge site.

reviews.author: Heidi G.
reviews.text: The campsite was clean and well maintained. The store was easily accessible and friendly. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Peter H.
reviews.text: Very peaceful and easy to see millions of stars right from the campsite

reviews.author: Tarek A.
reviews.text: Beautiful natural place, surrounded by many trees. Great distance to the neighbors.

reviews.author: Nancy B.
reviews.text: In spot B12.  Clear sky for solar and Starlink.

reviews.author: Patricia D.
reviews.text: My campground didn’t have a fire ring, yet the previous campers left me a whole bunch of scraps of wood on my bear locker and charred wood and ash in the small grill. They also left me a bag of potatoes. There was no pay phone anywhere on site, and I didn’t have any service the majority of the time. The folks at the store offered to let me use their phone, as I was solo traveling and needed to check in with my partner. The showers were ok. My site was not great for van camping — I could only park on the paved driveway. I was really annoyed by children whizzing about on scooters all night long. It was convenient and comfortable but not fabulous.

reviews.author: Elena C.
reviews.text: Close to Mazama village which has a store and showers. Poor cell signal.

reviews.author: nick t.
reviews.text: The sites are really large and spread out which we really loved!

reviews.author: Benjamin S.
reviews.text: The staff we interacted with were excellent and welcoming, the campgrounds were clean and easily accessible.  Please keep our national park service funded as well as the teams of people it takes to preserve these natural wonders for generations to come as intended when they were founded.  It was really nice to be able to charge my electric vehicle.

reviews.author: Thomas H.
reviews.text: Great place to camp nice, paved level rv spots .

reviews.author: Colleen C.
reviews.text: Awesome view, trails were well maintained and the park personnel were excellent

reviews.author: Taylor B.
reviews.text: The first bathroom on the right as you enter the F loop is actually the G loop bathroom.  If you are looking for the F loop bathroom which has showers, you need to go a little more than half-way through the loop to get to it (bathroom will be on the left if starting from the beginning of the loop).

reviews.author: Ricky w.
reviews.text: The restroom was only cleaned once in the 4 days we were there.

reviews.author: Jeff  H.
reviews.text: This place is beautiful! The campground is also well managed and the people working were very helpful!

reviews.author: Shawn D.
reviews.text: This was a great campground. The spots were big and had a lot of good tent spaces and it didn’t feel like there were many other people around, even though the campground was full.

reviews.author: Donca W.
reviews.text:
great campground.  nice having store and restaurant nearby
its best to be able to view sites before booking especially if you have an RV
   i was fine but some folks looked really cramped.

reviews.author: Julia K.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground with sites that are nicely spaced and wooded.   Bear lockers being at each site were really convenient.  The bathrooms are quite far from some of the sites, so just be mindful when choosing a site if this would be of concern to you and your family (eg. small children who need quick access).

reviews.author: Martin T.
reviews.text: Nice campground.

reviews.author: Amelia Kay W.
reviews.text: Very nice site and nice, clean campground.

reviews.author: Mary W.
reviews.text: We loved the campground but had one heck of a time getting our 35’ motorhome towing a 22’ trailer into and out of our site on the outside of Loop A. For big rigs, sites on the inside of loops work best.

reviews.author: Dawn R.
reviews.text: We were meeting our through hiking son. We arrived and waited in line for a first come first serve site in the E loop. Met really nice people in line and had a beautiful spot to camp. Well worth the wait. The park is very well maintained and we loved our three days exploring. A must see spot!

reviews.author: Catherine H.
reviews.text: Being able to camp just a short drive from spectacular Crater Lake was a bonus. Many wonderful hikes in the area. Handy internet access and T-Mobile service at the campground store.

reviews.author: Neil W.
reviews.text: Mazama Campground and the surrounding facilities are back to very good with the now second year management  company.  So recommend Mazama campground and facilities. The ongoing road construction/refresh can be frustrating so looking forward to that being completed.

reviews.author: Brenda W.
reviews.text:
Site is level, with nice placement of fire ring and picnic table. Lots of trees so it feels private; but there is a hiking trail that runs along the back of this site, so you’ll see lots of people wandering along.
Close enough to water spigot, small distance to waste bin, bathroom is a walk, with showers a long walk or short drive.

reviews.author: Brenda W.
reviews.text:
Site level with close proximity to water spigot. Bathroom is a small hike, and showers are a long walk to F Loop, or drive to store. Fire ring nicely situated, with stump seating and picnic table is easily accessible.
It got VERY cold at night, dipped into the 30’s, so be prepared!

reviews.author: Brenda W.
reviews.text: We rented RV electric space F28, and it was a great location. Adjacent to the main road, enough space to drive through, and close enough to the bathroom & showers, with a waste bin next to the site and water spigot right across the road.  With all the trees, there was enough privacy that we didn’t feel “exposed”.

reviews.author: Rosa C.
reviews.text: Well kept campground. Quiet

reviews.author: Amanda H.
reviews.text: The campground is large but doesnt feel overcrowded. The spots aren't very private but they are reasonably spread out and surrounded by pines. Plenty of water stations and bathrooms, but showers are only at the reigstration building. Only complaint is that site C1 doesn't have a picnic table so we had to use the bear box. Try to bring all supplies with you, the camp store has some but prices are high.

reviews.author: Denise B.
reviews.text: The campground was clean, the employees were friendly and helpful. There were many walks that were easy to moderate, providing wonderful views of the lake and the surrounding areas. Traffic near the Lodge in the afternoon was very busy. My only issue was that the campground store did not stock ice in bags smaller than 16 pounds. Overall had a great time.

reviews.author: Cassie O.
reviews.text: You could really tell that this place is getting ready to close for three years. It’s that or the current administration cut backs on national parks has really taken its toll. It was a pretty peaceful campground but very understaffed and not taken good care of. So sad.

reviews.author: Laura C.
reviews.text: My first time at the Mazama campground,  not my first time to Crater Lake.   Very nice campground, clean bathrooms, trash & recycle containers emptied daily.  Staff throughout the park was friendly and helpful.   There was however a bathroom on the loop next to our loop that was closed the 4 days we were there, the campers in D loop were using the bathrooms on C loop which in and of itself wasn't a problem,  but they were cutting through our campsite to get to them.  That's weird and annoying when a stream of people are walking in you campsite day and night.   Showers were located next to the Mazama Village store and were pretty moldy.   I showered in my RV instead.

reviews.author: Molly H.
reviews.text: Had a great stay at the campground. The loop we stayed in just had one bathroom, which was closed, so that was a bit of a pain to have to use another one. But minor inconvenience. Some of the sites are huge and pretty private. Camp store was great for any needs. Would definitely camp here again!

reviews.author: Wanda L.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at this campground. The camp sites were sold out while we were there, but we still felt we were separate and had a lot of privacy. The sites are laced out in a way that you’re not right on top of each other - mind you, we were in a tent only area. It may feel very different in the other areas. We like tent only! The spots and the facilities were clean and well kept!

reviews.author: Katherine P.
reviews.text:
It was a very busy site so if peace and quiet is your goal this isn’t it. 
The shop is very convenient and the staff is amazing. Crater Lake makes everything worth it.

reviews.author: Sara W.
reviews.text: Great campground in crater lake. Our site was right on the walking path but wasn’t bothered by it at all. Nice foliage separating the campsites. Close walk to bathroom. Very clean grounds.

reviews.author: William H.
reviews.text: Great place to stay in Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Judy M.
reviews.text: Facilities were really clean.  It is a beautiful location and the campsites are very well spaced to provide privacy and enjoyment of nature.  The showers were excellent.  We went to 2 ranger programs which were very educational.  We enjoyed the evening program and then watching the meteor showers.  Employees were friendly and helpful.  Had a wonderful overall experience.

reviews.author: Pablo C.
reviews.text: great campground, very clean, easy access to the bathroom, which was kept clean, and the store is walking distance with pleny of supplies for your stay

reviews.author: Emily S.
reviews.text:
We were in Loop G, campsite G2. This campsite is right next to the restrooms which was great, but at night the outside light does not turnoff. This light will shine into your tent, I recommending bringing a sleep mask. You will also get early morning noise with those visiting the restrooms. We were also one of the only campsites without a picnic table. 

The store was great, and nice to have available. They do sell out of ice early. Overall, the campsite was quiet and clean. We would revisit, but pick a different site.

reviews.author: Emily S.
reviews.text: We had a great time and the tent site was really spacious. It was relatively private feeling considering how many sites there are, and there were no street lamps to keep us up at night. The campsite had soft dirt that was easy to sink our tent spikes into, but also a lot of  tree stumps that were very "tripping you in the middle of the night" height. The restroom in our loop was out of service which we were not informed of. I thought it was strange that no one told us that when we were booking OR checking in, I feel like the sites in that loop maybe should have received a discount considering how far away the other restrooms were. But still, overall we had fun and swimming in Crater lake was 100% worth it!

reviews.author: Don M.
reviews.text: Private pull through. Beautiful grounds. Don’t miss Annie’s trail. AND Crater Lake’s Rim Trail. Got to be one of my absolute favorites!

reviews.author: Alice B.
reviews.text: The camp site itself was beautiful, and the camp ground in general was clean and well maintained.

reviews.author: devin W.
reviews.text: Very clean campground with fairly large sites. Wish we could have stayed longer!

reviews.author: Adrian P.
reviews.text: Sites were great. Access to the park was phenomenal. Beautiful views of the night sky.

reviews.author: Yasmine B.
reviews.text: Nice setting up campsite. The facilities were little short compared with the number of campers. a great location. Large campsites. Personnel not very helpful at the campsite shop

reviews.author: Abigail O.
reviews.text: Great campground with big camp sites, showers, restaurant and general store.

reviews.author: Angelena F.
reviews.text: Best campsite I've been to!

reviews.author: Elizabeth O.
reviews.text:
Showers are only available at main entrance and not at each loop.
Dishwashing stations aren't available (and host agreed I shouldn't use the water filling stations throughout the loops because any food can attract bears). 
Not a lot of foliage to separate our site from neighboring sites.

reviews.author: suzanne r.
reviews.text: Campground was amazing, sites huge. Our site was missing a picnic table, which was a huge inconvenience.

reviews.author: Annick C.
reviews.text:
This campground is too big.
Not our kind of camping.

reviews.author: JaAnna M.
reviews.text: Lovely campground with space and trees between sites. Clean bathrooms and showers. Although the shower discription online is a bit confusing. There are free showers in each loop.

reviews.author: Ted F.
reviews.text: Nice site.  Free hot showers was grand.

reviews.author: Eliot J.
reviews.text: Enjoyed our stay. Did not have a reservation but arrived early on a Thursday and had no problem get a site for our travel trailer.

reviews.author: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: RV campsites are spacious, lack of generators running was a plus, and access to the activities and sights throughout the National Park as a whole were easy to access. Can’t wait to come back!

reviews.author: Clifford B.
reviews.text: Excellent camping location for Crater Lake NP. Good facility with plenty of trees. Access to the camp store and gas was very helpful

reviews.author: Daniel D.
reviews.text: Great campground!  Very clean and nicely managed.

reviews.author: Crystal C.
reviews.text: Mazama Campground literally has everything you need, from the 24 hr access to hot showers to restrooms and delicious food at the restaurant! We can wait to return and explore more of the park!

reviews.author: Michelle H.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground and friendly staff!

reviews.author: Greg H.
reviews.text: camp was quite organized and clean. despite the fact that our site was second from the road, it remained relatively quiet throughout our stay. would certainly recommend.

reviews.author: Maeve B.
reviews.text: I loved camping here! Camped solo and felt safe the whole time. Bear box and site were clean, campground was beautiful, bathrooms were clean and stocked with soap and paper towels/toilet paper. Will be camping here again once a reservation opens up :)

reviews.author: Jasmine W.
reviews.text: Lovely campground in a nice setting. We were in Loop G which is the farthest of them all and as such, it was quiet. My only complaint is that our site didn't have a picnic table. We had our own small folding table and chairs but it did make the experience slightly less enjoyable.

reviews.author: Annette M.
reviews.text: These are very nice camp sites.  There is plenty of room for your gear/rig.  The woods are lovely.  The camp store is reasonably stocked.  The staff was incredibly helpful and kind.  Shout out to Reanna who worked with us to find a nice site to accommodate our change of plans.

reviews.author: Eric Z.
reviews.text: It was great to stay in the national park!  Clean bathrooms, nearby store for basics (though higher cost than outside the park), and friendly staff.  Sites a little close together, but no disturbances during our stay

reviews.author: Marilyn H.
reviews.text: We were assigned a 50 ft. drive through site for our 26’ travel trailer and thought that should more than adequately fit our trailer and truck. The site was plenty long but the drive in and out areas were bordered by trees, posts and large rocks making it hard to maneuver the truck and trailer into and out of the site. Beware that this campground is not big rig friendly. Our travel trailer is 26”.  Dump station is easy to access. They also charge tax on the nightly fee. We found this unusual for a recreation.gov campground.

reviews.author: Monique V.
reviews.text: The person at the registration desk was very unhelpful. He didn’t greet us or even offer us a map of the campground or any other information. When we arrived at our campsite, it hadn’t been cleaned. There was a large piece of used foil left on the grill as well as a huge log partially burnt left next to the pit, not to mention the profuse amount of mosquitoes that together made our stay disappointing.

reviews.author: Sally B.
reviews.text: Great campground with access to a well-stocked store, a trolley to the lake area, and a restaurant.

reviews.author: Ted L.
reviews.text:
Hike to the Watchman Overlook.
Hike the Castle Crest Wildflower Trail.
Hike the Pacific Crest Trail south from Highway 62.
Take showers in the restrooms next to the camp store.
Get cold drinks, sandwiches, snacks, and ice cream at the camp store.
Have a delicious breakfast, lunch, and/or dinner at the Annie Creek Restaurant.
Enjoy Wifi at the camp store and wifi and cell phone service at the restaurant.

reviews.author: Elizabeth  W.
reviews.text: Beauty beyond words. Bathrooms clean. Would have loved a shower but didn't take the time to find out where they were located. Enjoy!

reviews.author: Missy  K.
reviews.text: Helpful staff, spacious sites, clean bathrooms. Quiet.

reviews.author: gurjeet p.
reviews.text: Wonderful stay clean restrooms beautiful campsite

reviews.author: Lorenz M.
reviews.text: Campsite F3 is very private from both sides but open in the front. We were able to build the best campfires due to the fire pit design. Annie Springs trail is right there and acce3ssible between F9 and F11. Great hike.

reviews.author: Eleanore B.
reviews.text: First camping experience with little kids and it went great! Campsites were well maintained and bathrooms were clean. Annie Creek Canyon Trail was super close and one of our favorite hikes. We feel confident camping with our littles after this trip!

reviews.author: Joshua K.
reviews.text: 깨끗하고 조용하며 관리가 잘 되어 있었습니다.. 특별히 샤워시설이 아주 좋았습니다.

reviews.author: ANN R.
reviews.text: Loved our time at Matzama Village Campground!  Super clean!  Quiet. Respectful campers. Perfectly appointed sites.  Clean restrooms and showers.  Very helpful staff.  Loved the nature walk booklets at each trailhead.  Made our hikes so much fun!  Really enjoyed talking with the hikers walking the PCT. Excellent vacation!

reviews.author: Anne C.
reviews.text: This is a good campground with dense trees. G22 was relatively private, and right on the Annie Creek gorge.  The Annie Creek trail went along the back of the campsite, but there were huge trees down to make a barrier, so the hikers didn’t encroach on the camp site and weren’t a bother. The picture in recreation.gov did not correspond to the site. Many choice spots for a tent. The bathrooms were clean and well maintained.  G22 is near the end of the G loop and the bathrooms are at the beginning.  I measured the distance with my GPS watch, and a round trip to the restroom from G22 was a quarter mile. Water is right across the road from the site. The Mazama Village camp store has free showers.

reviews.author: Cornelia B.
reviews.text: Campground was first come first serve in loop E. We found a lovely space. The camp store host were friendly and helpful. Ice cream was delicious.

reviews.author: Jennifer T.
reviews.text: Only annoying issue with our site B10 was that the electric stand was not centered on the site.  It was down on one end that required us to park closer to it rather than where we would have wanted to park.  We had an extension cord but it wasn't long enough. Quiet campground even as full as it was. Unfortunately the laundry was not functional while we were there.  The showers were greatly appreciated though.  Only had wifi up at the store.

reviews.author: Robert S.
reviews.text: Nice campground within the park. The bathrooms were good. Could use some hangers in the bathrooms. Confused about the First Come campsites. Had to wait until 12 pm to actually get a site. And there was no guidance by the park staff to inform people about forming a line. Just groups of people standing around then chaos at 12.  You should be able to go get an unreserved site and come back to the office and then register that site.. first come. Or a least give out numbers to people so less chaos at 12.

reviews.author: Lydia B.
reviews.text: Campsite was large and secluded, amenities were excellent. One word of advice: if you’re someone who gets eaten alive by mosquitos make sure you bring your repellent because they were out in force!

reviews.author: Jacqueline I.
reviews.text: Beautiful forested campground with tons of fairly private, flat sites! Lots of garbage receptacles and easy access to spigots. Soap, running water, and paper towels in restrooms, but not enough stalls for the number of tent sites around each facility. Camp store had great selection of beverages and ice cream. About a 20 minute drive from Rim Village.

reviews.author: Maureen D.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground with lots of trees. Sites have large bear boxes, and campground loop has many water spigots, and nice restrooms. Lovely creek hike goes by the campground.

reviews.author: Helen V.
reviews.text: We came in without a reservation and the folks at the store gave us a choice of available sites in the E section. They were very friendly and easy.

reviews.author: Maxine S.
reviews.text: Great campground. Has all the necessities and a camp store for anything you might need. Bathrooms were stocked well  and they provide free shower locations. Something to note is that it is a super quiet camp by 9pm and gets pitch black as soon as it gets dark. Best part was that its only a 15min drive to Crater Lake.

reviews.author: Robert H.
reviews.text: Great campground with good spacing between sites adjacent to beautiful Crater Lake.  The hike along the gorge behind the campground was impressive.

reviews.author: Ben L.
reviews.text: Beautiful campground, super convenient campground store with gas and everything needed to make some easy microwave food. Also beer. Couldn't get any better.

reviews.author: Tania  j.
reviews.text: Clean bathrooma, campground and campsite. Despite it being the busy season it was quite quiet and enjoyable. Would definitely be back.

reviews.author: Nancy L.
reviews.text:
Restroom and shower room are very clean
Campground site keeps very clean and spaceous. Will come again

reviews.author: Roisin Q.
reviews.text: Nice sized campground and individual sites. Clean facilities

reviews.author: Rob L.
reviews.text: It was helpful to have WiFi by the store.  And I really appreciate the fueling station upgrade (with a free air hose!) and reasonably priced gas.

reviews.author: Laura P.
reviews.text: Mazama Campground is nicely wooded, and the sites have decent separation between them to allow for privacy. The water and dump fill station worked out great on the way in/out. There is also a water spigot across from the site (not threaded). Site F9 is in one of the best locations with the canyon on the camp side and trees between the neighboring sites. It is a huge site, though it's important to note that it isn't fully functional as a pull through. We have a 27 foot travel trailer and were able to drive in forward and position it well for solar (or shade, if desired). Due to the tree branches at the other side of the pull through loop (at about a 60 degree angle), it's not possible to drive out of the site without the branches coming into contact with the trailer. Instead, we backed out back onto the road, which worked out fine with some time and patience. The other unexpected aspect of this site is that the trail runs right behind it, so you will have people walking by regularly and there are no trees for privacy from the trail. This wasn't a major issue for us. In July, the waterfall wasn't flowing, though the creek down in the Canyon had some water that you could hear, but not see. And, you can get 2 bars of Verizon service about 50 feet away on the trail (not at the site itself). All in all, it was a good campground within about 10 minutes drive to the lake.

reviews.author: Carolyn M.
reviews.text: First come first serve site was great. Took boat to Wizard Island and climbed to the top of the cone (we scheduled it there the day before). Great service and overall experience.

reviews.author: Lori A.
reviews.text: Wonderful park! Adequate campground.

reviews.author: Christina S.
reviews.text: Great place to stay, nice campsites. Showers are available.

reviews.author: Holger K.
reviews.text: Really the best spot during our tour from seattle down to san francisco

reviews.author: M. E. B.
reviews.text: Nice large site. All the views of Crater Lake whether you drive yourself or take the trolley or boat tours. Connectivity was an issue though when we tried to book the Wizard Island boat tour, so highly recommend you book prior to your visit or at one of the on site locations (Rim Lodge or Mamzama Village) for the 24 hour ahead released tickets.

reviews.author: Tailor S.
reviews.text: Amazing campground. We stayed in loop D, and it was clean, quiet, and just overall an amazing experience. Made our summer!!

reviews.author: Brenda  C.
reviews.text:
We reserved a RV site  for July 14 with electric power (site F20). When arrived there was no electric power at our site. I went to the registraton office looking for help but the office was closed with a notice posted on the window saying "power outage"; It seems the whole camp ground was out of power that day; there was no light in the bathroom and no hot water for shower. 
I was disappointed that we could not have electric power that day at Mazama Village Campgrounda. Our portable power station was out of juice from the last camp site we stayed and we rely on this stay in Mazama to recharge our portable power station. After Mazama we traveled to another National Park that we need our portable power station to power our refrigerator for the rest of our trip.
We paid for a site with electricity but too bad that we did not get what we paid for.

reviews.author: Brian M.
reviews.text: Had site D 18. Camped in a 32’ fifth wheel. It is a pull through but better to back into with a bigger. Not many sites for bigger rigs so pick a site wisely. Interior roads have lots of branches hanging out but it’s manageable if you don’t mind them rubbing some but no damage. No Verizon service but WiFi available at Manama village gift shop within walking distance.

reviews.author: Robert C.
reviews.text: Campgrounds are well kept, as usual. We knew where we were staying , as we have been there before. Only set back was the staff the Mazama campgrounds. Seems they felt as guests, we were a hindrance to them. Maybe they should find other work if they do not like being there. The rangers at the Park Headquarters were awesome though, I must say.

reviews.author: Paul J.
reviews.text: Clean and well maintained campground in a beautiful place

reviews.author: Scott R.
reviews.text: The pull through site was wonderful.  It would hold a much larger rig than the 28 feet that was stated online.

reviews.author: Maureen M.
reviews.text: Nice campground!  I like FF = First come, first service.  Thank you, Staff to keep this campground beautiful!

reviews.author: Sheryl A.
reviews.text: Beautiful location, clean, well-hosted!

reviews.author: Alana T.
reviews.text: Close to the lake, easy to check in, and very clean inside. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Randy W.
reviews.text: Overall, we had a very positive experience. The restrooms were reasonably clean and the site was nice. One drawback of the site is the trail that basically runs through it. The restaurant nearby was a plus. The store was way overpriced.

reviews.author: Robert  W.
reviews.text: Crater Lake is spectacular and being able to stay in the park is so convenient. We stayed in a large RV full hookup site. The site was level and we could easily back out 41 foot 5th wheel in. The site was littered with trash though. There were plastic water bottles and bits of paper everywhere. We left it better than found.

reviews.author: Margaret E.
reviews.text:
I think the way ExplorUS is handling things is MUCH better than the last concessionaire. I REALLY like being able to reserve a particular site. (I've been camping at Mazama each summer for about 25 years.) 
Thank you for hiring a good concessionaire. (I also had a beautiful, informative boat tour.)
Be well,
Margaret Emerson

reviews.author: Christine J.
reviews.text: Loved the cozy campground design. Clean restrooms and extremely welcoming staff.

reviews.author: Zheyun S.
reviews.text: The shower in loop F didn’t have hot water. And the shower in the information building closed at night but no open time was indicated anywhere.

reviews.author: Amber M.
reviews.text: Loved the campground!

reviews.author: Dave R.
reviews.text: Great campground.  Very clean and plenty of services.

reviews.author: Jeffrey H.
reviews.text: FCFS. There were a few spots left at about 3 PM. Check in was quick and the lady was friendly. I got a great site.

reviews.author: Frank H.
reviews.text: Crater Lake campground at Mazama Village, 200 sites, second week in July, no reservation, plenty of spaces available, spent 3 nights, used shower facility in F loop--no charge, private, and plenty of hot water. Several neighbors came and went, all nice. Pitched 3 tents in tent site, plenty of room. Great experience.

reviews.author: Thomas N.
reviews.text: The campground site for parking and tent camping was great (for an RV site). However, the picnic table was in terrible condition, couldn't balance anything, and the fire pit was a makeshift pit where the grill was locked in place and obstructed the firewood.

reviews.author: Isaac B.
reviews.text: Nice campground! The bathrooms need some updates. The showers were free when we were there but the drain was clogged so that was less than desirable. Campsite was nice, not the most level but it worked. About 10 min from the rim of Crater Lake so thats a plus! Overall, not a bad campground.

reviews.author: Jennifer M.
reviews.text: Lovely campsites with plenty of space. Trash & recycling receptacles readily available. Bathrooms were clean and well stocked. The showers were disappointing. The water did not drain and we were in standing, non draining water to shower.

reviews.author: Carri  B.
reviews.text: Clean bathroom. Quiet at night. Spacious campsite.

reviews.author: Barbara H.
reviews.text: The E loop is FCFS, 55 sites. Only drawback is to get a site, you have to wait in line. The line doesn’t start moving until 2:00. We arrived at 1:00, walked the loop for desirable sites. At 1:30, there were already about 15 in line. We got our site at 2:45, it was a very slow moving line. We got the site we requested which was large with shade and sun. Very clean bathrooms. Will visit again.

reviews.author: Sam P.
reviews.text: Loved this campsite - if you come to the store by 1pm and get in line you can snag a first come first served site. Annie's Creek is gorgeous, right behind the campsite - lovely spot, good services.

reviews.author: Amy R.
reviews.text: There are lots of trees in the park which makes it nice. They only Wi-Fi is at the store. Also the only shower is at the store which is a bit of a walk or a car ride away from the camping spots.

reviews.author: Heather T.
reviews.text: Pretty good for a large campground. The sites are decently spaced with nice driveways. Nice hiking trail nearby. Bathrooms weren't the best (one sink with cold water only) but flushing toilets.

reviews.author: Andie P.
reviews.text: Relatively quiet campground (had one party show up late and make noise into the morning), lots of sites, drinking water close by and bathroom close too. Our site was right next to our neighbors which was quite invasive- our tent was next to their picnic table. Overall would love to come back to another site.

reviews.author: Oleksandra  S.
reviews.text: Great campground, good size of sites

reviews.author: Adam  A.
reviews.text: Great spot near the base of Crater Lake, I would recommend. There is also a trail by the campsite that goes into the valley, however, bring bear spray. There are only 3 showers each for men and women. Showers are ok, I didn't have to wait, and you don't have to put in quarters to activate the shower.

reviews.author: Phileo M.
reviews.text:
Beautiful campsite!!!! We met a very nice and knowledgeable ranger which was great.
Unfortunately some of the people visiting have no clue of camping etiquette i.e. quiet time and staying out of others campsites! Also when a sign says “Trail closed” it’s for a reason!!!! Come on people be respectful!!!!

reviews.author: Julia B.
reviews.text: Typical federal campground, sites comfortably sized but close together with no privacy, bathrooms well maintained, camp store well stocked with friendly staff and showers clean. Most important is Location within Lassen Volcanic NP. Gorgeous park.

reviews.author: Lindsey M.
reviews.text: Quiet campground with ample room between campsites on the west leg of the G group. The only concern was there was only one restroom for all the campers, which created a bit of a wait in the morning.

reviews.author: Doria A.
reviews.text: The campground was clean for the most part, but they are definitely suffering for help. By Saturday, the bathrooms were disgusting and we knew it was because they did not have help to keep up with all the campers. There were a lot of fallen trees throughout all the sites, which definitely helped those of us with axes to cut wood vs purchasing. Our fire grate was literally covered by a tree and we didn’t see it until our 3rd day under the tree. We made a rock pit to burn in the evenings. Other than that, a nice campground.

reviews.author: Sarah A.
reviews.text:
This is a great way to experience Crater Lake. Especially as I was there on the holiday weekend, the lines to get into the park were long, but no problem if you're already in there.
I did the trolley tour on this visit, and I recommend that too, it is very informative.

reviews.author: Thomas S.
reviews.text: Friendly staff, very large site. Clean bathrooms. Loved our stay. Beautiful Lake!

reviews.author: Ray S.
reviews.text: Nice clean campground.  A little crowded on July 4th.  Much better after that.

reviews.author: Maria  I.
reviews.text: What a beautiful campground! Everything was well kept and the bathrooms were brand new.  We would go back to this campground.
